_comment: Ratchet for wall-clock reads in trading-decision modules (2026-10-13). Counts are the reviewed baseline of `Date.now()` / zero-arg `new Date()` per file. A change that ADDS a read must either use the simulation/replay clock seam or consciously raise this baseline in the same review. Market-time decisions (freshness, session, cooldown, expiry) must not use the real clock inside a synthetic session; latency/ids/log timestamps may.
